final: WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pl.throws),''),'') AS hand FROM player_award pa JOIN player pl ON pl.player_id = pa.player_id), c AS (SELECT hand, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS cnt FROM p GROUP BY hand), s AS (SELECT hand, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL)/(SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share_of_kept, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
